questions.question:
Choose the correct sentence using reported speech.
He said, 'I have just finished my homework.'
options: He said he has just finished his homework.
He said he had just finished his homework.
He said he was just finishing his homework.
He said he would have finished his homework.
questions.answer: He said he had just finished his homework.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the following statement?
'I must tell you that I'm not happy with the decision.'
options: She said that she must tell him that she wasn't happy with the decision.
She said that she had to tell him that she wasn't happy with the decision.
She said that she must tell him that she wasn't happy with the decision.
She said that she must have told him that she wasn't happy with the decision.
questions.answer: She said that she must tell him that she wasn't happy with the decision.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the verb in the passive voice.
Your report _______ tomorrow morning.
(A) is being presented
(B) will be presented
(C) will present
(D) presents
options: is being presented
will be presented
will present
presents

questions.question:
Which option correctly completes the sentence with the passive voice?
The house _______ by thieves last night.
(A) broken
(B) was broken
(C) breaks
(D) is broken
options: broken
was broken
breaks
is broken

questions.question:
Select the correct reported speech form.
He said, 'I have been working here for five years.'
options: He said he has been working there for five years.
He said he had been working there for five years.
He said he was working there for five years.
He said he would be working there for five years.
questions.answer: He said he had been working there for five years.

questions.question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence with reported speech.
She said, 'I will call you tomorrow.'
options: She said she would call me the next day.
She said she would call me tomorrow.
She said she will call me the next day.
She said she would call me the following day.
questions.answer: She said she would call me the next day.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly reports the statement using the passive voice?
'The new bridge will be opened next week.'
options: It was said that the new bridge would be opened the following week.
It was reported that the new bridge would be opened the next week.
It was said that the new bridge would be opened the next week.
It was reported that the new bridge would be opened the following week.
questions.answer: It was reported that the new bridge would be opened the next week.

questions.question:
Select the correct reported speech form.
He said, 'If I had more time, I would help you.'
options: He said if he had more time, he would help me.
He said if he had more time, he would have helped me.
He said if he had more time, he would help me.
He said if he had more time, he would be helping me.
questions.answer: He said if he had more time, he would help me.

questions.question:
Complete the sentence with the correct form of the conditional.
If I _______ you more about the project, would you have agreed?
(A) had told
(B) told
(C) would tell
(D) tell
options: had told
told
would tell
tell

questions.question:
Which option correctly completes the sentence with the third conditional?
If I _______ harder, I _______ the exam.
(A) studied, would have passed
(B) had studied, would have passed
(C) studied, would pass
(D) had studied, would have passed
options: studied, would have passed
had studied, would have passed
studied, would pass
had studied, would have passed
